name: Pepper Jack
siboNotes: Well-tolerated on SIBO diets as it's naturally lactose-free due to aging process. The spices used are typically FODMAP-friendly.
preparationTips: Check ingredient list to ensure no garlic or onion powder is added
Grate fresh rather than buying pre-shredded to avoid anti-caking agents
Allow to come to room temperature for best flavor
Pairs well in moderation with low-FODMAP crackers
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of calcium for bone health
